fights.notes: Printed as twenty minates. Kelly gave in (threw in) for McCoole, so Allen won. Article is an obituary-style recollection of McCoole.

notes: Recollections from a Philadelphia correspondent about McCoole, who died in October 1886. Allen appears only in the two fights; the other McCoole bouts are not Allen's. Excerpts contain the OCR error Ailen and Mike are named McCoole in the text.
